A full school day earns 10 XP, Saturday 8 XP, Sunday 2 XP, for 60 XP a week. Badge XP is logged separately in your XP Tracker. No homework today? Do 20 minutes of study, review, or a learning app instead.

My four daily goals

Small and steady beats big and skipped. Pick something you can do even on a busy school day.

Spiritual
Ideas: Scripture or devotional · Prayer · Gratitude journal
Physical
Ideas: 10 push-ups · Walk or bike 15 min · Stretch & drink water
Mental
Ideas: Practice a skill 10 min · Flashcards · Learn one new thing
Social
Ideas: Serve a sibling · Text or call someone · Act of kindness
